title: 9.4 Experimental Design

icans: I can describe a randomized comparative experiment and identify the treatment and control groups.
I can tell an experiment from an observational study.
I can identify problems in an experiment’s design.

vocab: compares a ____________ group with a control group
the group that does not (it may get a __________)
a harmless, ______________ treatment that looks like the real one
subjects are randomly assigned to the ____________ or control group
repeating an _____________ with many subjects so results aren’t due to chance
observes subjects without ____________ a treatment; it can’t show cause and effect

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: A good experiment: A good experiment has a _______________ group and a _______________ group, _______________ assignment, and enough subjects (_______________).

blocks.stem: A company tests a new energy drink. 100 volunteers choose whether to drink it or water before a run, and their times are compared. Is this a randomized comparative experiment? Explain.
60 patients are randomly assigned to take a new sleep pill or a placebo, and their hours of sleep are compared. Identify the treatment group and the control group.

notes: Cause and effect: Only an _______________ can show cause and effect.

blocks.stem:
Tell whether each is an experiment or an observational study.
a.  Researchers compare the test scores of students who eat breakfast with those who don’t.
b.  A teacher randomly assigns half of a class to study with flashcards.
An experiment tests whether music improves typing speed. 10 students who like music type while listening to it, and 10 students who don’t like music type in silence. Describe the problems.
A study records how many hours teens sleep and their grades. Is it an experiment or an observational study? Can it show that sleep causes better grades?
To test a new acne cream, a company gives it to 15 volunteers, and 10 of them improve. Describe the problems with the design.

tickets.stem: Why does an experiment need a control group?
Researchers survey people about their exercise habits and their heart health. Experiment or observational study?
Why do researchers randomly assign subjects to groups?
